title: Build an independent inference engine
choose_when: A new runtime must own execution, memory and device integration on a distinct OS, model or hardware stack.
steps: Prove model loading and one operation on the target device.
Complete one end-to-end output, including fallback and lifecycle checks.
Measure resident memory, correctness and cold/warm behavior on the actual OS and hardware.
acceptance_evidence: An independently runnable target-native engine, adapter boundaries and target-device validation results.
